verdict.rationale: Lambda ships a preinstalled 'Lambda Stack' with standard AI/ML drivers/tools/frameworks and offers a minimal 'GPU Base' image, plus CUDA/Open MPI preinstalled on Slurm clusters and a vLLM deployment walkthrough on Managed Kubernetes—showing some pre-configured ML environments rather than a curated template gallery. However there's no evidence of named, selectable templates for PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, or ComfyUI as distinct launch options; ComfyUI is never mentioned at all.  missing for 10: explicit named template/image options (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) selectable at launch, a template marketplace/gallery, and independent confirmation of ease-of-use.
